# Code of Conduct

## The Basics

Be respectful. Everyone interacting in this project—through issues, pull requests, or
comments—is expected to treat others with courtesy and good faith.

## What's Not Acceptable

- Harassment, personal attacks, or discriminatory language
- Trolling, insulting comments, or sustained disruptive behavior
- Publishing others' private information without consent

## Enforcement

I'm the sole maintainer and reserve final judgment on what stays. Violations may result in
removal of comments, rejection of contributions, or blocking from the project.

That's it.
